verdict.summary: The change is documentation-only and accurately retires the stale deferral language. The new comments match the implemented fully-hidden circuit and verifier path: the verifier derives the accepted-set root and version floor from its own policy, rebuilds the proof public inputs, cross-binds the issuer-signed reference and index commitments, and records their pair in the shared single-use store. The relevant end-to-end linkage-reuse test exercises two presentations under distinct verifier nonces and expects the second to fail, rather than merely testing a helper. The research-grade and external-audit caveats are explicit, including the operational requirement that the issuer re-blind and re-sign for each presentation. No hostile instruction appears in the diff.
